title: The Numbers Behind The Knicks Title Run Are Absurd — And Everyone Is Coming Back
description:
A full statistical breakdown of the Knicks championship core heading into next season. Jalen Brunson led the entire postseason with 539 points and owns the largest playoff scoring jump in league history. Karl-Anthony Towns turned into a passer at exactly the right moment. OG Anunoby shot 48.9 percent from three in the playoffs with only ten turnovers in 17 games. And Josh Hart out-rebounded most starting forwards in the NBA at six foot five.

Contracts, ages, injuries and the plus 283 point differential that set an NBA postseason record — every number that explains why New York is the team to beat.

Who matches up with this roster? Tell us in the comments.
